action.new_text:
# Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be NumPy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D matrices")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must have the same shape")
    n, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if n == 0 or horizon == 0:
        raise ValueError("Empty matrices not allowed")
    if np.any(np.isnan(logp_with_result)) or np.any(np.isinf(logp_with_result)) or np.any(np.isnan(logp_call_only)) or np.any(np.isinf(logp_call_only)) or np.any(np.isnan(logp_no_call)) or np.any(np.isinf(logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must contain only finite values")
    if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be nonpositive (log probabilities)")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or tau_filter < 0 or np.isnan(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative non-boolean float")
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw / np.sum(raw)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_with_result = -np.sum(weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
    margins = L_minus - L_with_result
    keep = margins >= tau_filter
    return keep, margins
